definitions: To risk everything by investing all of one's resources or efforts into a single venture, plan, or option.
To concentrate all of one's hopes or resources on one thing, so that if it fails, one loses everything.
examples: Don't put all your eggs in one basket; diversify your investments.
She decided not to put all her eggs in one basket and applied to several universities.
It's risky to put all your eggs in one basket when starting a new business.
lemma: put all one's eggs in one basket
source: put all one's eggs in one basket
